question_record.context: In connection with a security incident involving credential theft tool execution and the dropping of dual-purpose tools on a device, a suspicious file was registered as a service, likely for persistence. This activity was associated with a specific account.
question_record.question: What is the name of the account linked to the suspicious file that was registered as a service?
solution: A malicious credential theft tool was executed by a user with AadUserId `1d94aaf6-efe6-4e76-ad56-ffd7d1257bc1`.
Multiple dual-purpose tools, including `psexesvc.exe`, were dropped on a device.
A file registered as a suspicious service by a user with account name `fk8mq`.

85.name: Malicious credential theft tool execution detected
85.description:
A known credential theft tool execution command line was detected.
Either the process itself or its command line indicated an intent to dump users' credentials, keys, plain-text passwords and more.

62.name: Multiple dual-purpose tools were dropped
62.description:
Multiple known public tools, which could also be used for malicious reasons were dropped on this device.
Attackers might download or copy multiple dual-purpose tools to the target device to perform various attack stages including, credential theft, privilege escalation, and lateral movement.

21.name: Suspicious file registered as a service
21.description: A file with suspicious attributes or involved in possible breach activity was registered as a service. An attacker might be attempting to register the file as a service for persistence.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID' AND o.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
parameters: Malicious credential theft tool execution detected
